changelog.title: Comprehensive Mobile UI Refactor
changelog.description: Executed a systematic mobile optimization sweep across the platform. Rigid desktop grids on the AI Threat Dashboard, GRC Assessment tool, and Security Articles hub have been refactored into fluid stacked layouts. Improved header real estate, fixed the duplicate bell icon collision, and optimized touch targets for seamless mobile navigation.

changelog.title: Command Center Launched
changelog.description: We have successfully rolled out the new Command Center notification panel. This feature allows users to track the latest cyber intelligence articles and site updates instantly from the global navigation bar. It utilizes local browser storage to keep track of unread items and integrates a smart pulsing indicator.

changelog.title: Core Web Vitals Optimization
changelog.description: Performed a major overhaul of the site's front-end architecture to drastically improve loading performance. We resolved high Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) issues caused by font loading, deferred non-critical JavaScript, and implemented aggressive Cloudflare edge caching strategies to ensure sub-second response times.

changelog.title: ISO 27001 GRC Engine Update
changelog.description: The ISO 27001 GRC assessment engine has been upgraded to a professional, audit-ready compliance tool. We integrated the mandatory Management System Clauses (Domain 0) as a foundational requirement and shifted from binary scoring to a CMMI maturity scale for granular compliance insights.

changelog.title: Threat Feed AI Pipeline
changelog.description: Refactored the automated news summarization pipeline. We replaced the legacy generation scripts with a robust GPT-4o implementation, ensuring highly accurate, context-aware security news summaries that sync directly into our Hacker Chatter and intelligence feeds.
